identification: Two round silver plated bowls, 17 cm and 11 cm, twisted (swirl) fluting inside, reeded band at rim. Matches the Christofle 'Torsades' vintage bowl (catalogue 1981-2000), which Christofle makes in 17 cm and 11 cm sizes. No maker mark visible in either photo (underside not shown).
